GO_VERSION.description: Specific version of go to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GO_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install GO. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

GOPROXY.description: Go module proxy URL or 'off' to disable network module fetching.

GO_VENDOR.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating Go should build using local vendor directory (-mod=vendor).

GO_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading go binary or archive artifacts.

GO_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying go available remote releases.
